dataList.content:
The heavy rain and the tempest only grew harsher the closer we got to the manor.
越接近宅邸，风雨越是猛烈。
dataList.place:
Wuthering Heights Gardens
呼啸山庄 庭院

dataList.content:
Though we have long made it past the front gate, not a soul doth appear...
明明吾等已经通过了正门，却未看见任何人影……

The bubbling excitement of the Sinners when they disembarked the bus had all but disappeared. Silent air of apprehension surrounded them as they gingerly took their hesitant steps toward the manor.
与刚下车时截然不同，罪人们在紧张感的裹挟之下，只是一味地向前迈步。

Cathy! Have you been well? No… Catherine, it has been a while, hasn’t it? No, this ain't it either…
凯茜，你过得好吗？不对……凯瑟琳，好久不见了，不对这也不行……

In the midst of this aura of uneasiness, only Heathcliff seemed to be preoccupied by something else. The rest of the Sinners were—
在这紧张的气氛中，似乎只有希斯克利夫带着不同的目的在迈步，其他人都……

Didya catch that…?
看到了吗……？

A bird. A subspecies of sparrows, to be exact.
嗯。是鸟类。准确而言是麻雀的亚种。

Lightning continues to strike aggressively… even this far past the front gate.
即使我们已经通过正门，这攻击性的落雷也仍然在持续。

We would’ve been burnt to a crisp had it struck even a little closer…
如果再靠近一点，我们也会落得那样的下场……

Lightning continued to blast the earth, as though it wouldn't be satisfied until it's reduced every living thing in the manor grounds to a pile of ashes.
雷电似乎要将踏入呼啸山庄正门中的一切生命焚烧殆尽才肯罢休。

Is it gonna hit us if we walk faster? Or maybe it hits things that are moving too slowly? Maybe we should speed up? I don’t know…
走太快了会被雷劈，走慢了也得被雷劈……

Our walking speed seems irrelevant. Instead, it's almost as if this lightning has a will of its own, striking with intent. 
... This brings back some... unpleasant memories.
和移动速度应该没有关系。这雷电似乎是凭借自身意识在进行瞄准。带有自我意识的闪电……让我想起了不好的东西。

Ohh~ Maybe it’s like this house’s defense system?
啊~难道这是……这座房子的防御系统吗？

Defense system… Do you imply that this may be a part of the manor's security measures?
防御……你是指安保装置吗？

Maybe it only targets things that enter the manor grounds without permission.
也许这些落雷只会攻击未经许可擅闯宅邸的东西。

I've seen security measures that are more precise and more... conclusive than this.
比这更精巧准确的装置也有很多。

Larger manors often do install more effective security systems, after all.
因为越大的宅邸就越需要设置有效的安保装置嘛。

Ohh… I think our family talked about installing a defense system at our home, too. It was one of those topics that kept coming up during dinner.
啊……我家也是，我记得家里在晚餐时也会谈论安保装置的话题。

... That would make sense. Not that I’ll ever understand the thought process behind these… systems…
……虽然这并非无稽之谈。但这不意味着我就能理解……

Perhaps the ‘security measures’ that prevented the Before Team from approaching the manor may be…
令LCCB小队无法接近的安保体系，也许就是……

Yeah… But we have the invitation with us! I think we’ll be just fine.
没错，但……我们不是有邀请函吗。安安心心走过去就好啦。

Is that really all this is?
是这样吗？

Is this just one of those normal security measures that every rich family supposedly has?
这真的只是……稀松平常的，富裕人家的安保系统而已吗？

This is pretty interesting, though. I heard that the technology to change the weather itself is really, really expensive to the point of being inefficient. So expensive that I’ve not seen it myself.
但也有些不可思议呢。调整天气的系统不仅效率低下，也会花费非常多的成本，我还没有亲眼见到过呢。

I remained silent because I didn't want to concern the Sinners with something I wasn't sure about...
虽然因为不敢确定，我没能告诉大家。

But the closer we got to the manor, the more confident I became that something was off.
但越接近宅邸，我越有一种确信感。

That this extremely abnormal weather… isn’t the work of some security system.
这异常的气候变化……并不是简单的安保系统。

This absolutely has something to do with a Golden Bough.
这明显是，受到了金枝的影响。

But...
但是……

This Golden Bough feels different from the ones we've encountered before.
和以往金枝给我的感觉不同。

It's a bit more... chaotic...?
似乎更加……混乱……？

Oh? Huh, these flowers...
啊，这些花……

... they've got color!
它们有颜色？

Sinclair was right. The manor’s garden was lightly littered with flowers; they were the only things of color in this dreary sight.
正如辛克莱所说，作为唯一带有颜色的事物，绽放的花朵四处点缀着宅邸的庭院。

I wonder what these flowers are called?
这些花，叫什么名字？

Huh, I guess you can return the colors even to flowers if you cough up enough cash?
虽然只是猜测，是不是只要付钱……就可以取回花的颜色？

Indeed.
没错。

Then the proprietor of this manor must have held a particular love for these flowers.
换言之，此家的主人对花甚是喜爱。

To return the colors to such transient things as flowers...
甚至为生命短暂的花卉添上色彩……

Or, perhaps, it may simply be that they are preposterously affluent.
抑或是，相当阔绰的富豪……

Heathcliff quietly gazed at the patches of violet flowers as Yi Sang mused out loud.
在李箱进行推测的时候，希斯克利夫静静地注视着那些紫色的花朵。

You're wrong.
不对。

There was no particular love for these flowers.
那家伙不可能会喜欢这些花。

There was no room, no warmth in that heart to spare for mere flowers.
那家伙的心，可还没宽阔到能温暖地包容几朵花。

Heathcliff appeared so doleful that I felt as though he had built a tall, opaque wall between himself and the world. I could not bring myself to ask further.
他阴沉的脸色像是筑起了一堵墙，让我无法继续询问。

He did not tell us the name of those flowers.
希斯克利夫他，直到最后也没有告诉我们那些花的名字。

dataList.content:
My, oh my!!! Please, come this way!!!!
天哪！！！欢迎光临！！！！

Someone hurriedly runs this way from the manor's front door, holding a lantern.
我看见有人手里拿着提灯，从宅邸正门跑过来。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
What an awful weather, hmm? Well, T Corp. is… the Wuthering Heights manor is rarely ever sunny, but this is quite the storm!
天气很反复无常对吧？呀，在T公司……在这呼啸山庄里就没见过几次好天气。

… Long time no see, Nelly.
好久不见，耐莉。

... My word, Heathcliff? Is that you? It really is you!
难道是，希斯克利夫？真的是你！

Y-yeah...
嗯……

You haven't the slightest idea how worried I was since you left! Have you been eating well? You’ve not been bullied by a rough crowd, have you?
你就那么一声不吭地离开了……那之后是怎么生活的……？有好好吃饭吗……？没再总是挨打吧……？

<Bullied by a what…?>
<挨打……？>

We’ve wanted to hear from you for so long!!
我们盼你的消息可盼了太久了！！

Do come in now, come in!
来！快进来。

This ‘Nelly’ regarded us with a curious look, as though she didn’t quite understand what we were supposed to be…
名叫耐莉的人以难以置信的眼神看着我们……

If I may be so bold as to presume…
难道，各位是……

Would you be our dear Heathcliff’s friends?!
是我家希斯克利夫的朋友吗？！

Ahem...
嗯哼……

Yeah, uh, well...
嗯，算是……

Friends...? Are we?
朋友……我们算吗？

The answer to that question hinges on the range of affinity one would define as a delineation that separates friends from acquaintances.
根据对友人定义范围的认知差异，答案也会有所不同。

‘Course we’re friends~ Precious friendship, forged in fire! Multiple fires, actually!
当然啦~我们可是一起跨过好多次生死危机的超级珍贵的朋友呀~

Your dear Heathcliff’s precious friends are about to freeze to their deaths in the rain, woman.
你家希斯克利夫重要的朋友们现在因为淋了雨快被冻死了。

My, what honourable guests I welcome to this place today! I must be all over the place to leave you all standing in the rain! Come in now, come in! It’s a tad warmer in here than it is outside.
哎呀，多好的客人们！你看看我可真是的。快请进来。来！宅邸里可是暖洋洋的。

The interiors of Wuthering Heights was rather dark, yet...
呼啸山庄宅邸内十分昏暗，而另一方面……

This manor… doth have color.
宅邸中……真的……有颜色。
dataList.place:
Wuthering Heights Entrance
呼啸山庄 玄关

dataList.content:
Its hue appeared a tad faded from its original vibrancy, but...
虽然与原本颜色相比稍微褪色了一点，

… there was color in this manor.
但这座宅邸中确实存在颜色。

What’d I tell you? I could see colour inside this manor.
我说过吧。宅邸里能看见颜色。

Well... it's all bought by money, anyway.
这也是……花了钱才取回来的。

Believe it or not, there's something about these lanterns hanging about the manor that brings back colours.
只要把这些提灯挂在宅邸里，应该就能取回颜色了。

Ah, the lanterns that return the objects' original saturation. These are quite the expensive luxuries, are they not?
能照亮原色的提灯。这一定是相当昂贵的道具。

It still doesn’t bring all the colours back. Things still remain a tad gloomy.
虽然这么说，但还是没法完全拿回原来的颜色。总还是有些暗淡。

So where’s Cathy—
说起来凯茜她在——

Heathcliff! Please, tell me of your life since you have left us, hmm? Where have you been staying? Have you been eating well? My, have you lost weight?
希斯克利夫！你至今为止是怎么过的？嗯？在哪里住？有好好吃饭吗？你是不是有些瘦了？

Huh? Uh… I…
啊？呃……我……

I’m glad your delay wasn’t too substantial. We have all been waiting for your arrival.
但我还是很高兴你还没回来得太迟。大家都还等着你呢。

We…?
大家……？

Now let me get a better look at you. The refined dress clothes, the hair... My, you’ve certainly grown into a right proper gentleman, haven't you? Quite the popular lad you are, with a posse of friends and all.
说起来，你的衣着也十分精致，像是个十足的绅士了。还交了这么多朋友。

Well… Hm… D-did I?
啊……嗯哼……有、有吗？

But of course! I would not have recognized you from a distance.
当然啦！我从远处都快认不出你来了。

Nelly was talking so fast that Heathcliff wasn't spared even a second to get in a single word.
名为耐莉的人，在希斯克利夫能说出一句完整的话之前就滔滔不绝起来。

Nelly… was it?
是叫耐莉……没错吧？

What is your precise relation to Heathcliff? As his precious friend, colleague, and comrade in arms, I cannot help but be curious as to how you two know each other.
你们具体是什么关系？我们是他重要的友人、同事以及战友，因此对你们二位之间的关系有些好奇。

Outis, who was conspicuously scanning the interiors of the manor, suddenly asked Nelly the most transparently suspicious question that I’ve ever heard.
显眼地环顾宅邸内部的奥提斯向她提出了明显有所意图的疑问。

Oh, I’m… let’s see… Heathcliff’s... hm, how should I put this?
啊呀，我啊，是希斯克利夫的……可以说是……

... Nanny, I suppose?
算是保姆吧。

Nanny...?
保姆……？

What, like… you wiped Heathcliff's snot, changed his baby clothes, and... am I thinking of the right 'nanny'?
就是……帮他擦鼻涕……给他换衣服……的那种保姆？希斯克利夫先生的？

And when the baby’s fussy about the food, nannies spoon-feed it to them.
要是他不愿意吃饭……就会用勺子舀起来送进他嘴里之类的。

Oi, Nelly! Quit teasin’ me like that.
喂，耐莉！别这样介绍。

You weren’t exactly my ‘nanny’, and you know that.
和保姆……也有点不一样。

We’ve known each other since we were both young.
我们从小就认识。

And I did not treat her like a servant or follow her around like she was my nanny.
我没把耐莉当成仆人使唤，也没当做保姆一样事事跟着她。

Fuhu. Mind you, I am now the Chief Butler of the house. You must see the other Butlers moving about like soldiers when I give a word!
呼呼，现在我可是首席管家了。只要我一声令下，就能差使一群管家。

… Well, you were the best at your job.
……毕竟，你做事一直又快又好。

Nelly, I’m… getting quite impatient. So I’ve got to ask…
话说回来……我差不多忍到极限了，耐莉。

Heathcliff must have wanted so badly to ask her where Cathy was.
“凯茜在哪里？”希斯克利夫一定很想这么问……

So when’s the… banquet starting?
宴会……什么时候开始？

Instead, he hid his true question behind a mask of aloofness.
他十分生硬地将最想询问的问题咽了回去。

But...
但是……

Nelly's expression became somewhat odd upon hearing Heathcliff's query.
耐莉的表情有些微妙。

The banquet...
宴会……

Oi! When’s that witless brigand coming? Is he even on his way?
喂，那小流氓还没来？他脑子里怎么想的？

dataList.content:
You can’t just leave after gathering us all down here! If I have to sit any second longer next to these mugs, I’m going to lose it!
把人叫来这里又给我玩消失，是想干什么？还要让我盯这些人的臭脸到什么时候！

There was a furious voice echoing from down the halls.
里面传来了怒吼声。

Nelly, wait… I recognize that voice…!
耐莉，等等……刚刚那个声音是……

My, don’t rush! He just arrived, mind you!
天哪，真是。稍安勿躁，他这就到了！

Let's join the others, Heathcliff. Like I said, we've all been waiting for your arrival.
希斯克利夫，进去吧。说过大家都在等着你吧。

Heathcliff bit his lips anxiously and followed Nelly.
希斯克利夫咬紧嘴唇跟在耐莉身后。

This… doesn’t feel at all like a manor that’s about to throw a party...
……怎么看都不像是派对的氛围啊……？

Yeah, that cruise ship party, this manor…
是的，不管是之前的游轮派对……还是这次的……

You can’t hide the rising sense of dread from places like these. Doesn’t matter how hard you try.
不管怎么隐藏……这种弥散四处的阴暗氛围……都是藏不住的。

This manor does not appear to have been a place where liveliness is an expected element.
这座宅邸平日里似乎并不热闹。

I see signs of rushed cleaning, conducted immediately before the guests arrived. Several cracks and areas in need of repair have been identified as well.
打扫得十分匆忙，看来仅仅是为了迎接客人。墙面有多处裂痕，能确认到需要修补的部分。

Also…
另外……

I was scant expecting a raucous par-tay, yet… this is quite the depressing presentation...
……即使吾未曾期待愉快的派对……但仍不免有些沮丧……

I followed Don Quixote to the halls. She appeared terribly disappointed.
我和看上去尤其消沉的堂吉诃德一起走进了大厅。
